children: Overview
Canada venture builder's Q2 revenue rose 421% yr/yr to C$28.0 mln, driven by Hydreight
Q2 net income increased to C$2.5 mln from C$0.4 mln a year earlier
Company attributes growth to Hydreight and fair-value adjustments in portfolio investments
Outlook
Hydreight reaffirms fiscal 2026 revenue guidance of approximately $150 mln
Company prioritizes supporting Hydreight's growth and advancing healthcare investments in second half 2026
Company maintains focus on disciplined capital allocation across its portfolio
Result Drivers
HYDREIGHT GROWTH - Co said Q2 revenue growth was primarily driven by Hydreight Technologies' expansion in U.S. healthcare infrastructure and pharmacy operations
PHARMACY SALES IMPACT - Hydreight's pharmacy product sales increased and changed revenue mix, contributing to lower gross margin due to pricing concessions
FAIR-VALUE ADJUSTMENTS - Co said net income was also attributable to fair-value adjustments in portfolio investments
